# Summary and Questions


## TFIM supermacy

This section covers the TFIM supermacy. Specifically, it replace the IQP circuit, $P(s) = |\bra{s} U_{\rm IQP} \ket{0^n}|$, with:
$$
\begin{align*}
U_{\rm IQP}=W^{\otimes n}e^{-iH_Z}W^{\otimes n}, \quad
H_Z &= \sum_{i \in \mathcal{V}_{\mathcal{G}}} v_i Z_i +\sum_{(i,j)\in \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{G}}} J_{ij} Z_iZ_j,
\end{align*}
$$
to a more general TFIM circuit $P(s) = |\bra{s} U_{\rm TFIM} \ket{0^n}| ,\, U_{\rm tot}=U_R U_{\rm TFIM}(T) U_L$, where $U_{\rm TFIM}(t)$ follows the time-dependent Hamiltonian:
$$
\begin{align*}
H_{\rm TFIM} &= A(t)H_X+B(t)H_I, \\
H_X &= \sum_{i \in \mathcal{V}_{\mathcal{H}}} X_i, \quad H_I = \sum_{i \in \mathcal{V}_{\mathcal{H}}} v_i Z_i +\sum_{(i,j)\in \mathcal{E}_{\mathcal{H}}} J_{ij} Z_iZ_j.
\end{align*}
$$

To get specific relation between $U_{\rm TFIM}(T)$ and $H_{\rm TFIM}$, we take $H_I$ as interaction and use the interactive picture, i.e., the transformation 
$$
\begin{align*}
\ket{\tilde{\psi}(t)} &\to G_X(\alpha(t)) \ket{\psi(t)} :=  e^{ - i \left[\int_0^t A(t') dt'\right] H_X}\ket{\psi(t)}.
\end{align*}
$$

Then we concludes $U_{\rm TFIM}(T) = G(\alpha(T))\widetilde U(T)$ with $\widetilde U(T)$ follows:
$$
\begin{align*}
\widetilde U(t)&=\mathcal T\exp\left[-i\int_0^t B(t')\widetilde H_I(t')dt'\right],\\
\widetilde H_I(t)&=G_X[-\alpha(t)]H_I G_X[\alpha(t)].
\end{align*}
$$

The total evolution $U_{\rm tot} = U_R  G(\alpha(T))\widetilde U(T) U_L$ is definitely different from $U_{\rm IQP}$.
